question.text: Assume Rs. 50 lakh exits in year 2 of investment. Max permissible exit load (regulatory):

explanation.text: The Logic: The second-year exit load is capped at a maximum of 2% of the amount redeemed. Second-year cap = 2% of amount redeemed = 2% x Rs. 50 lakh = Rs. 1 lakh. The Trap: Rs. 2 lakh would imply a 4% load on the Rs. 50 lakh redemption, which exceeds the 2% regulatory cap for year 2. Note: Always apply the 2% cap to the redeemed amount in year 2, not to the original investment or any other base.
